# Liquid Glass optical engine

`liquid-glass.js` is the unmodified v1.0.0 engine served by https://liquidglass.dev/lib/liquid-glass.js, from https://github.com/gentpan/liquidglass at commit `068ad226f53e1ca62d857f78bdc32f58f3c5fce7` (retrieved September 27, 2026).

SHA-256: `92a62e5b80cfa7e03912b13bdc53aff1c0ae367a5f296de1327e0f62f0579210`.

Copyright (c) 2026 gentpan. MIT license, retained in `LICENSE`. Only the optical engine is bundled; the reference site's components, spring controller, styles and demo media are not used. `liquid-glass.d.ts` describes the subset of the public API used by this project.
